records.accessibleText: 2 Aryan goes on a journey. He leaves home at 11 40 and arrives at 14 18. Find how many hours and minutes the journey took. ................... h .................... min [1]

Anya runs 12 km at x km/h and next day walks 10 km at (x−4) km/h. (a) Running time. [1] (b) Walking time. [1] (c) Show the condition that walking is 1 hour longer simplifies to x²−2x−48=0. [4] (d) Solve by factorisation. [3] (e) Find running time. [1]
records.independentSolutionText: Running=12/x; walking=10/(x−4). Set 10/(x−4)−12/x=1; clearing denominators gives x²−2x−48=0. Factor: (x+6)(x−8)=0, so x=−6 or 8; valid speed x=8. Running time=12/8=1.5 h.

The binomial expansion of (1 + kx)ⁿ is given by 1 + 12x + 28k²x² + … + kⁿxⁿ, where n ∈ ℤ⁺ and k ∈ ℚ.

Find the value of n and the value of k.
records.independentSolutionText: From C(n,2)k² = 28k², n(n − 1)/2 = 28, so n(n − 1) = 56 and n = 8. The x coefficient gives nk = 12, so k = 3/2.
